lines.text: Many learners say: Ana is a friend of me.
Better: Ana is a friend of mine.
Mine! She is a friend of mine.

data.wrong: Ana is a friend of me.
data.right: Ana is a friend of mine.

native.tip: Dizemos “amiga dele” (de + ele); por analogia sai “of me”, mas em inglês usa-se “a friend of mine”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Ana is a friend of me”. O certo é “Ana is a friend of mine”. Por analogia com “amiga dele” (de + ele), muita gente diz “of me”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “mine”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: Portuguese says “amiga dele” (de + ele), so learners copy it as “of me”; English uses “a friend of mine”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Ana is a friend of me”. The right way is “Ana is a friend of mine”. By analogy with “amiga dele” (de + ele), many people say “of me”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
